title: Reminders
body:
If you’re like me and you need a helping hand organising your life and paying bills, then Reminders is a useful tool.
An added bonus is that it integrates into Calendar so all your appointments are supported by your to-do list. 
The Grocery app also uses reminders so you can share your grocery lists with other iCloud users. I’ve found that Reminders requires more detail than Siri and your voice command can handle but the more detail you provide the more balanced and well organised your life will become. I rate this app 4 stars.

title: Not that good anymore
body:
I have been using this app daily for the past 4 years and I have loved using it. 

Recently every time I click on the app it shows a black screen for about 2 minutes before quitting off. I then try clicking on it again and it opens and shows my lists but it completely frozen (so that I can’t do anything on the app). I then have to fully exit the app (and sometimes even restart my iphone) for it to then actually let me access my reminders.

When the reminders show up in my notifications and I try snoozing them (e.g., remind me in an hour) they stay there and don’t go away like they used to.

This isn’t ideal considering pretty much my whole life is in this reminders app and, as mentioned earlier, is used daily.
